logos.inUseEvidence: Commons identifies the joint National Union–NRP campaign logo but mistypes the year as “200d”. Its cited Ynet campaign-launch article was retrieved directly: title האיחוד הלאומי-מפדל: הימין שלנו יהודי; publication metadata 21 February 2006. Together these identify the 2006 election; visual tracing remains community evidence. Asset download returned HTTP 429 (Retry-After: 600); no local image is provided.
